trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 was the latest deploy (unhealthy in production); v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0** — rollout executed and verified in all three regions.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and its verification — the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was already healthy in production.
